spindle.observe.ServedKind.title: ServedKind
spindle.observe.ServedKind.description: What one operation of the model a served run routes is.

spindle.observe.ServedOperation.title: ServedOperation
spindle.observe.ServedOperation.description: One command or view a served run routes, and whether it serves it. An operation not served keeps its route and answers `501` naming the construct; `reason` is the text the run prints for it at startup (`b10x-spindle: not served: <kind> <name> at <method> <path>: <reason>`) and `admit` prints for a view, read from one place (`spindle_ingress::Route::not_served`). A served command may still refuse an outcome, which the startup line `unsupported outcome` names; it is served here.

component.description: The component whose route it is.

name.description: The qualified name of the command or view.

method.description: The route's method, uppercase, as the binding or ESS publishes it.

path.description: The route's path template, as the binding or ESS publishes it.

served.description: Whether a request for it is answered by the model.

reason.description: Why it is not served; absent for one that is.

spindle.observe.ServedOperations.title: ServedOperations
spindle.observe.ServedOperations.description: The answer of `GET /api/served`, a console route of a served run: every command and view it routes, served or not, in the order its startup lines name them: component by component, commands then views, each by qualified name. Computed once, when the run starts.
